newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 9.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 9.

text.p: These were the main headlines from Estonia's Kuku radio noon news report on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Tallinn stock exchange index rose above 300 points for the first time.
- Ukraine and the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation sign a special charter
